doc: Display grade of spec 17 §5.6 (lift and gain in Blender's form, saturation about Rec.709 luma, black crush) and the flat backdrop (8-bit display) that transparent-film hero renders are composited over; grade.py --measure-backdrop rewrites the backdrop.
round8: Take 2, round 8: lift and gain neutral, no black crush. Measured over the hero crops (scripts/tools/look_stats.py), the reference's darks are neutral to warm (r/g 1.0-1.15, b/g 0.85-0.93), not teal, and with the round-8 lights (scene.py: key 5800 K) the ungraded neutrals already land on the reference's (gain 0.96, 1, 0.98); spec 17's teal lift and warm gain pushed the shadows blue (shade gain 1.25, 1, 0.67) and the crush darkened every black part. Spec 17's values were lift [0.985, 1, 1.025], gain [1.035, 1, 0.96], black 0.02.
